notes: Matching per prompt_align.md (strict). Kela caseworker and Kela system are treated as the same actor; where they differ this is stated in match_type_note. Citizen/landlord nodes are not matched to Kela-side reference steps, except G11/N18 (one electronic rental-agreement transfer seen from either end; noted). Reference steps with actor 'unclear' accept any actor. match_type: exact = same unit of work (possibly split over several nodes, noted); partial = covers only part; merged = the node also covers other reference steps. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference order, where both are matched; pairs whose matched node sets share a node are skipped (listed in summary); up to 60 pairs. Shortest directed paths over all generated edges, taking the minimum over all matched node combinations in each direction; same_order is true only if the forward path is no longer than the reverse path, 'not_connected' if neither exists.
